enterprise-decision-states.title: Who decides each enterprise state?
enterprise-decision-states.description: Enabled everywhere, disabled everywhere and selected-organization states are decided by the enterprise; only let organizations decide hands the policy to organization settings.

delegation-and-defaults.title: Follow an unconfigured GA feature
delegation-and-defaults.description: The enterprise default for new features decides an unconfigured GA feature; when it delegates, an organization setting or the organization default decides.

license-source-tracing.title: Membership is not the seat source
license-source-tracing.description: Only organizations that grant the user a seat contribute delegated settings; billing selects one organization but does not narrow the policy inputs.

enterprise-assigned-users.title: Which setting decides a delegated policy?
enterprise-assigned-users.description: Fixed enterprise states apply to everyone; for a delegated policy, organization-seated users follow the organization while enterprise-assigned users follow a separate default.

least-restrictive-rule.title: Any enable wins
least-restrictive-rule.description: For delegated policies on the least-restrictive list, a user seated by two organizations is enabled everywhere if either organization enables the feature.

most-restrictive-exceptions.title: Which conflict rule applies?
most-restrictive-exceptions.description: Least restrictive is the usual rule across organizations; a short list of sensitive policies uses most restrictive, semantic indexing needs explicit enables, and multiple enterprises usually use most restrictive.

resource-scoped-controls.title: User scope and resource scope
resource-scoped-controls.description: User policies come from seat sources and conflict rules; repository exclusions and cloud repository access apply to everyone working in the resource, so both scopes must allow an action.

surface-coverage.title: Where selected policies apply
surface-coverage.description: A subset of the supported surfaces reference: coverage differs by policy across IDEs, the cloud sandbox, GitHub Actions, CLI, the Copilot app and code review.

feature-visibility-triage.title: Triage a missing feature
feature-visibility-triage.description: Rule out the account and client first, then check the enterprise state, seat-source conflicts and resource or surface gaps before recording the deciding step.

model-availability-triage.title: Does the model default apply?
model-availability-triage.description: Enterprise teams mode replaces organization model settings; otherwise the model status decides whether the default availability for released models applies.

effective-policy-records.title: Fields in an effective-policy record
effective-policy-records.description: Eight fields mirror the trace: policy and date, enterprise state, seat sources, conflict rule, resource controls, surface, result and owner.

drift-and-change-evidence.title: Revalidate records when inputs change
drift-and-change-evidence.description: Review who can change policies, query Copilot audit events, compare them with each record and update records with evidence, then repeat.
